image_description: A low-angle shot of a large, white parabolic satellite dish or radio telescope antenna. The dish is tilted upwards against a blue sky with light clouds. The interior surface is visible, showing panel seams and a central feed horn assembly supported by struts. The bottom edge of the dish is partially obscured by green tree foliage in the foreground.

It lacks the massive infrastructure usually seen dwarfing surroundings; it looks more like a standard communications uplink dish.
The dish exhibits a clear, smooth concave curvature consistent with a parabolic reflector.
